item.title: Inmates Clash Inside Rajouri Jail; Authorities Rush to Control Situation
item.description: A clash erupted among inmates inside a jail in Rajouri after an argument between two prisoners escalated into a scuffle. Authorities intervened after stone pelting on guards, deploying additional personnel and tightening security inside the prison premises.

item.title: Delhi, UP see warmer days while hills remain cold; Says weather report
item.description: Weather conditions across North India are gradually shifting from winter to summer. States like Uttar Pradesh, Delhi, Haryana and Punjab are experiencing mild cold mornings but warmer afternoons.

item.title: Tehran Oil Depot Attack: Massive strikes hit Iran fuel storage sites; Fires and smoke grip capital
item.description: Multiple fuel storage facilities in Tehran were reportedly targeted in strikes amid the escalating conflict in the Middle East. Israeli forces confirmed attacking several fuel storage complexes allegedly linked to Iran’s military operations.

item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Ahmedabad gears up for IND vs NZ final with high-tech security measures
item.description: Ahmedabad has implemented extensive security arrangements ahead of the T20 World Cup final between India and New Zealand at Narendra Modi Stadium. More than 3,000 police personnel, around 1,000 home guards and anti-drone systems have been deployed to ensure safety.

item.title: Delhi CM Rekha Gupta condemns youth’s brutal killing in Uttam Nagar; Orders strict action
item.description: Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta condemned the brutal killing of a 26-year-old man in Uttam Nagar during Holi celebrations. The dispute reportedly began after a water balloon thrown by a child splashed color, escalating into violence.

item.title: Donald Trump reacts as US allows India temporary relief to buy Russian oil; Details here
item.description: US President Donald Trump said the temporary permission allowing India to buy Russian oil aims to reduce pressure on global energy markets amid rising tensions in the Middle East. The United States granted India a 30-day window to continue imports as disruptions around the Strait of Hormuz threaten supply routes.

item.title: “Integrity and Leadership Shape Society”: Key Takeaways from Eminent Guests at DME Degree Distribution Ceremony
item.description: Delhi Metropolitan Education hosted a Degree Distribution Ceremony on 7 March to honour the graduating batch of 2021–2024 from its Media and Management Schools. The event celebrated students’ academic achievements and marked the beginning of their professional journeys.

item.title: 16,000 kg Gold owner predicts price spike amid geopolitical tensions; Here’s how much it could rise
item.description: Indian billionaire Joy Alukkas, owner of 16,000 kg of gold, predicts gold prices will rise amid ongoing Middle East tensions. Speaking from Dubai during recent drone attacks, he emphasized that geopolitical risks drive investors towards safe-haven assets.

item.title: T20 World Cup Controversy: Players demand quick exit from India; ICC’s decision sparks uproar
item.description: T20 World Cup 2026 teams face travel chaos as Middle East tensions disrupt flights. South Africa’s Quinton de Kock and West Indies players expressed frustration over ICC’s decision to send England home first, while their teams remained stranded in India.

item.title: Life-threatening attack on Ashutosh Brahmachari on train after filing case against Shankaracharya
item.description: Ashutosh Brahmachari, who filed a sexual harassment case against Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand, survived a life-threatening attack on the Rewa Express between Sirathu stations.
